shared.restore: Restore same checkpoint420 model and Adam independently for both arms; reset all supported training RNG state to pair seed before each arm.
shared.training_seeds: Same explicit deterministic per-slot streams from accepted uniform512 training pool; no evaluation seed use.
shared.selection: No interim model selection. Save fixed final actual-gameplay-frame checkpoint only.
shared.frame_accounting: Sum actual returned gameplay elapsed_raw_frames. Count startup frames separately. Keep complete final vector call and optimize every collected row. Stop before next vector call after target; do not synthesize or skip frames.
shared.claims: Equal gameplay frames; no equal-compute claim. One paired trajectory, not replicated training runs. No promotion or automatic adoption.

evaluation.primary: Paired Q1 difference repeat1_final minus repeat4_final under the same repeat1 inference controller.
evaluation.secondary: Each final model versus starting420 at repeat1; all repeat4 outcomes secondary.
evaluation.selection: Fixed final-frame checkpoints; no best-of-time selection.

resource_qualification.scope: Disposable model and Adam only; no evaluation, D9 seed use, checkpoint write, or weight reuse. Formal arms restore checkpoint420 anew.
